Codex Whip 1.10.0
Codex Whip gets its own identity, and an optional whip sound.
• Whip Sound in the menu plays a short crack each time a retry goes out. It starts off. • The app now has its own identifier, com.turushan.codex-whip, with nothing left of its earlier name. • Your settings, pending waits and history carry over. macOS keeps Start at Login and Automatic Updates per app identifier, so turn them on again once from the menu.
Also in this release: a cleaner menu, a clearer Activity window, working copy and paste in the message editor, and the new film in Watch Demo.
macOS 14 or later. This community build is ad hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
